age.evidence: Adult male Wistar rats were bred and raised in the animal facility

sex.evidence: Adult male Wistar rats... randomly allocated into 8 independent groups ( n = 10/group)

dosing.evidence: either saline or Ayahuasca drink (250, 500 and 1000 µg mL -1 ) was administered by gavage... Thirty minutes after drug injection, the animals underwent the sexual behavior test

group_housing.evidence: The animals were housed in group in a colony

day_night_flipped.evidence: 12:12 h light-dark cycle (lights on at 07:00 h)... tested... during the dark phase of the light-dark cycle (19:00 h)

assays.assay_description: Plexiglas cylinder arena (45 cm diameter), male introduced 5 min before a receptive female, 30 min observation under dim red light. Measures: latencies to first mount/intromission/ejaculation, number of mounts and intromissions preceding first ejaculation, total mounts/intromissions/ejaculations.

setup_habituation.evidence: Paper describes training with receptive females but does not state habituation to the testing apparatus specifically

setup_restrain.evidence: A male was introduced into the arena 5 min before a female (freely moving in Plexiglas cylinder arena)

food_restriction.evidence: Standard 30-min behavioral test in Plexiglas cylinder arena; no food in apparatus

water_restriction.evidence: Standard 30-min behavioral test in Plexiglas cylinder arena; no water in apparatus

time_to_assay.evidence: Thirty minutes after drug injection, the animals underwent the sexual behavior test.

outcomes.summary: Ayahuasca alone significantly decreased the number of intromissions and total intromissions at all doses in control rats. In sleep-deprived rats, the low dose (250 µg/mL) increased intromissions while the intermediate dose (500 µg/mL) decreased them. No significant effects on mount/intromission/ejaculation latencies or on counts of mounts and ejaculations.
outcomes.statistics: Kruskal-Wallis followed by Mann-Whitney; CTRL Ayahuasca vs CTRL-sal p<0.002, p<0.004, p<0.006; PSD-sal vs CTRL-sal p<0.02; PSD-500 vs CTRL and PSD-sal p<0.01 and p<0.006; PSD-250 vs respective groups p<0.01 and p<0.02
outcomes.evidence: Ayahuasca alone significantly decreased sexual performance at all doses. However, in sleep deprived rats, the lower dose increased sexual performance while the intermediate dose produced a detrimental effect on sexual response compared to the CTRL rats at the same dose.

judge_notes: All three candidates identified a single behavioural assay (Sexual Behavior Test); consolidated as one.
B1: Selected score 3 (7+ measures) following majority (qwen, gptoss) since the paper lists 8 distinct measures (3 latencies + 2 pre-ejaculatory counts + 3 totals).
Food/water restriction: Set to 'during' (high confidence) since standard 30-min test apparatus has no food/water — this is the canonical case per rubric.
setup_habituation: Marked 'not_reported' with low confidence; the sexual training is for selection of experienced males, not apparatus habituation per se.
